Heavy Truck Spare Parts Catalog - Engine group 01

|Part No.|Description|Qty|Fits|
|---|---|---|---|
|74200001|Cylinder head gasket|1|FH16 / D13|
|74200002|Engine oil filter|1|FH16 / D13|
|88-2214|Caliper bolt kit front axle|2|LT-300|
|74200010|Tire pressure sensor|4|FH16|

[[page 2]]
Torque the cylinder head bolts in three stages: 60 Nm, 120 Nm, then 90 degrees.
Replace the cylinder head gasket 74200001 whenever the head is removed.
Check tire pressure on the steer axle after any front-end work.
